description.value: The Relief is a 1929 West Coast fishing vessel permanently moored on display beneath the Granville Street Bridge in Vancouver. It is one of the hidden gems of Granville Island, offering cyclists passing through the seawall and island area a glimpse of BC's maritime heritage. The site is an outdoor, publicly accessible exhibit managed under the Granville Island umbrella.
